pending.title: Pending
pending.intro: Questions and decisions that agents leave for you or your team appear here.
pending.identity: The recipient helps you find a request; anyone with panel access can answer it. The name entered does not verify identity.
pending.emptyHelp: When an agent needs an answer from you or your team, it will appear here.
pending.error: Could not load requests. Try again.
pending.notWaiting: This request no longer waits for an answer. Refresh the list.

noAnswer.timeout: The agent did not answer in time. Ask again or decide with what you have.
noAnswer.no-origin: This request does not come from a conversation, so there is nobody to ask.
noAnswer.unavailable: The agent could not be reached. Ask again or decide with what you have.

pending.cannotAsk: This request does not come from a conversation: the agent cannot be asked.
pending.askHelp: The agent answers in its conversation and the answer appears here. The request stays open until you decide.
pending.asked: Question sent. Waiting for the agent's answer; this view updates by itself.
pending.askFailed: The question could not be processed. Refresh and review the request.
pending.askSlow: The agent has not answered yet. Refresh later.
pending.changedElsewhere: The request changed while you were looking at it. It was refreshed; review it before continuing.
pending.savedResumeFailed: Could not confirm whether the response was saved. Do not submit a different answer; check the status in Automations or retry exactly the same response.
pending.sendError: Could not send. The request may have changed; refresh and try again.
pending.unsupported: This form contains unsupported fields. Open the run in Automations to answer it.
pending.answerRequired: Choose an option or write an answer before sending.
pending.responderRequired: Say who you are above, under “I am”, before answering.
pending.questionRequired: Write the question before sending it.
pending.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? The agent is told it was cancelled.

delivery.pending: Telling the agent is still pending.
delivery.processed: The response was processed. This does not confirm that the agent completed its work.
delivery.failed: The response is saved, but telling the agent failed. Check the history; do not submit a different answer to this request.
delivery.invalid: The saved response or choices are invalid. Ask the agent to create a new request; this response was not delivered.
delivery.unknown: Could not confirm whether the agent was told. Check the history.

pending.resumePending: The response is saved, but the request could not be resumed.
pending.resumeQueued: Resuming was requested. Refresh to see the result.
pending.resumeError: Could not request resuming. Try again.
pending.historyEmpty: No closed requests for this filter.
pending.historyError: Could not load the activity. Refresh to try again.
pending.historyLimited: Showing up to 20 recent requests. Check the history for more.
pending.answerHistoryNote: No response is available in this request’s history.
pending.outputsError: Could not load the saved response. Close and reopen this request to try again.

people.title: People
people.intro: Organize the people taking part in this project.
people.shared: People use the project’s shared access. This list does not create accounts or verify identities.
people.error: The operation could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
people.name: Name
people.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the list? Existing requests will keep their recipient.
people.changed: This person changed or was removed. Refresh the list before continuing.
people.bizNote: People with access to the project in Fyso Biz appear here automatically and are managed there. You can still add other people by hand.
people.locked: This person is managed in Fyso Biz and cannot be changed here. Refresh the list.
